title: Equisetum arvense tea for medicinal use
intro: Equisetum arvense tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried stems of the field horsetail plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism for its high silica content, which is believed to support joint health and bone strength. The tea is often consumed to promote urinary tract health and as a diuretic. It may also be used to aid in the treatment of respiratory conditions and to support the detoxification process. However, it should be used with caution due to its potential to cause kidney issues if not prepared or consumed properly.
